topic: Two siblings inherit their grandmother's house
text: I can't believe we're even having this conversation. This house, our grandmother's house, should be a place of memories, a sanctuary. Instead, it's just another thing to divide, another point of contention. Just because we both have a right to it doesn't mean we should have to split it. She spent more time here, laughed more here, cried more here—this should be hers. Now, we're supposed to treat it like any other asset, to be bartered and sold. It’s demeaning to her memory, to me, to everything it stands for. If we can't agree, someone else will decide its fate, and that's just wrong.
